pages.text: You attempt to temper an iron axe using the ancient techniques of the Piglins, resulting in a Nether version of the Rampaging Axe wreathed in flames. You feel this style suits you well as a Nether mage.
Retaining all the functions of the Rampaging Axe, this axe also sets creatures on fire and deals additional damage to burning targets.
Can be repaired with Cursed Metal Ingots on an Anvil.
